purpose: Demonstrate a governed reporting pattern that prepares routine facts, exposes conflicting or unsupported statements, requires explicit review, and releases a report only after required controls are satisfied.
verified_operating_behaviors: seven routine facts prepared from governed sources
milestone conflict requires explicit reviewer selection
forecast narrative is not invented when unsupported
high risk cannot finalize without an accountable owner
finalization blocked until all review controls are satisfied
reviewed report, exception log, and ownership record produced
reset restores a clean starting state
public maturity and non-claim boundary remains visible

acceptance.execution: Portfolio CI executes the Playwright suite across configured desktop, tablet, and mobile projects.

production_adaptation_requires: approved source systems and report ownership
defined reporting calendar and controlled KPI definitions
source-of-truth rules for schedule cost risk and action data
baseline report effort and quality measures
operating documentation training and administrator handoff
not_claimed: production AI extraction or summarization accuracy
measured client time or financial savings
autonomous interpretation of material project impacts
